properties.name: Faculty of Engineering
properties.description: Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, and Biomedical Engineering blocks (Blocks A–Y) with DK1–DK9 lecture halls and Menara Kejuruteraan.
properties.history: Established in 1958 during UM's foundation in Kuala Lumpur. Pioneered professional engineering education in Malaysia with international Washington Accord accreditation.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 4,200 undergraduate & postgraduate engineering scholars

properties.name: Faculty of Computer Science & IT
properties.description: Block A (M16) & Block B (M15) housing DK1, DK2, BK1–BK2, Micro Labs MM1–MM6, Stroustrup Lab, CCNA Lab, VLSI Lab, and Robotic Lab.
properties.history: Traced back to UM's first mainframe Computer Centre in 1965, elevated to autonomous Faculty in 1993. Malaysia's top computing hub for AI, data science, and software engineering.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 1,800 undergraduate and graduate AI & software engineering students

properties.name: Faculty of Science
properties.description: Blocks J01–J50 & KDK covering Mathematics (ISM), Physics, Chemistry, Geology, Biological Sciences, Bioinformatics, and Zoology Museum.
properties.history: One of UM's four foundation faculties established in 1959. Renowned for discovery-driven research in biotechnology, chemical physics, applied mathematics, and geological sciences.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 3,500 natural science researchers, PhD fellows, and undergraduate scholars

properties.name: Faculty of Arts & Social Sciences
properties.description: Blocks I01–I08 including Siswarama, Dewan Kuliah A–F, Pejabat Dekan, Dataran Sastera, and Dataran Siswa (The Cube).
properties.history: The intellectual heart of Malaysian liberal arts, literature, and social sciences since 1959. Has educated prime ministers, national laureates, historians, and international diplomats.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 3,000 students in humanities, media, international relations, and social theory

properties.name: Faculty of Education
properties.description: Blocks I09–I17, Menara Pendidikan (Block G), Auditorium I15, Research Hub (D' Agora), and CITrA (I16).
properties.history: Established in 1963 to spearhead national educational policy, teacher training, and pedagogical psychology in independent Malaysia.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 2,100 trainee educators, master practitioners, and PhD scholars

properties.name: Faculty of Business & Economics
properties.description: Azman Hashim Building (H15), H08–H12 Postgraduate & Lecture Blocks, Blocks A & B (DK Lim Goh Tong), and Graduate School of Business.
properties.history: Formed from the historic Faculty of Economics & Administration (1966) and Business & Accountancy. Dual AACSB and AMBA accredited, training leaders across central banks and finance.
facilities: Graduate School of Business Financial Trading Lab
properties.capacity_stats: Over 3,800 business leaders, chartered accountants, and economic researchers

properties.name: Faculty of Built Environment
properties.description: Mercu Alam Bina (G26), Architecture & Urban Planning studios, Quantity & Building Surveying blocks, and Built Environment Library.
properties.history: Established in 1995 to cultivate professional architects, quantity surveyors, and town planners with RIBA and PAM international accreditations.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 1,400 architecture, surveying, and urban planning design scholars

properties.name: Faculty of Languages & Linguistics
properties.description: Angsana & Beringin Lecture Halls, Dewan Persidangan, Bangunan Anggerik & Bakawali, and FLL Language Resource Library.
properties.history: Began as the Language Centre in 1972 and elevated to Faculty in 1999. Offers proficiency and degree programs in 10 global languages with simultaneous interpretation suites.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 1,600 language scholars, translators, and international linguists

properties.name: Faculty of Law
properties.description: Bangunan Sultan Azlan Shah (C01), C02, C03 Lecture Hall, Auditorium Tun Mohamed Suffian, Moot Court, and Law Library.
properties.history: Founded in 1972 under founding Dean Tan Sri Ahmad Ibrahim. Malaysia's foremost law school, producing Chief Justices, Attorneys-General, and High Court judges.
facilities: Tan Sri Ahmad Ibrahim Moot Court
properties.capacity_stats: Over 1,200 future advocates, solicitors, legal scholars, and judicial officers

properties.name: Faculty of Creative Arts
properties.description: Old Chancellery Building, Dewan Tunku Canselor (DTC), Panggung Eksperimen (Experimental Theatre), Music & Dance Studios, and Piyadasa Gallery.
properties.history: Spearheads Malaysia's performing arts, traditional Nusantara heritage, and contemporary music. Stewards the historic Dewan Tunku Canselor and Panggung Eksperimen.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 900 performing artists, music producers, and cultural researchers

properties.name: Faculty of Medicine
properties.description: Medical Faculty Blocks F02–F13, F38, Dataran Pelajar (Centrepoint), Clinical Skills Unit, Biomedical Science, and Forensic Wing adjacent to PPUM.
properties.history: Established in 1963 alongside the teaching hospital. Pioneered Malaysia's first open-heart surgery, liver transplants, and WHO-certified infectious disease containment.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 3,200 medical doctors, clinical specialists, surgeons, and biomedical researchers

properties.name: Faculty of Pharmacy
properties.description: Pharmacy academic wing (F15 & teaching labs/lecture halls) next to Faculty of Medicine and PJ Gate.
properties.history: Grew from the Department of Pharmacy into an autonomous Faculty in 2019. Ranked among the top 100 pharmacy institutions in the world by QS World Subject Rankings.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 650 clinical pharmacy students and pharmaceutical research scientists

properties.name: Faculty of Dentistry
properties.description: Dental Complex Blocks F20–F23, Dental Specialist & Research Tower (F22), and Balai Ungku Aziz (D25).
properties.history: Malaysia's first dental faculty established in 1972. Operates advanced patient clinical suites providing specialized public maxillofacial and restorative dental care.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 800 dental surgeons, maxillofacial specialists, and orthodontic scholars

properties.name: Faculty of Sports & Exercise Sciences
properties.description: UM Arena Stadium, Pusat Sukan (P01), Olympic Swimming Pool (P02), Squash Complex (O06), and Exercise Physiology Labs.
properties.history: Founded as the Centre for Sports Science in 1995, elevated to Faculty status. Premier training and biomechanics facility for national athletes, Olympians, and sports directors.
facilities: UM Arena Stadium (400m synthetic running track)
properties.capacity_stats: Over 750 sports scientists, elite athletes, and sports management practitioners

properties.name: Academy of Islamic Studies
properties.description: API Blocks A, B, C, D and Surau API near the northern Damansara Gate.
properties.history: Formed in 1996 from the historic Nilam Puri Kelantan Islamic Foundation roots. Southeast Asia's foremost academy for Islamic jurisprudence, ethics, and contemporary thought.
facilities: API Blocks A, B, C, D
properties.capacity_stats: Over 2,200 scholars in Islamic jurisprudence, finance, and contemporary theology

properties.name: Academy of Malay Studies
properties.description: Academy of Malay Studies complex featuring Dewan Semarak, Bilik Mesyuarat Kiambang, and Malay Manuscript/Resource Centre.
properties.history: Established in 1989 to champion Malay socio-cultural heritage, linguistics, and literature. Operates the university observatory and rare classical manuscript collections.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 950 researchers in Austronesian linguistics, Malay literature, and regional folklore

properties.name: Centre for Foundation Studies (PASUM)
properties.description: Blocks B01–B44, B07 New PASUM Building, B16 PASUM Tower, B23 Dewan Kuliah Utama (DKU), and Ambang Asuhan Jepun.
properties.history: Established in 1977 as Malaysia's premier pre-university foundation institute, channeling top national SPM achievers into medicine, engineering, computing, and science degrees.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 2,400 matriculation and foundation scholars each academic session

properties.name: Chancellery & Central Admin
properties.description: Bangunan Canseleri (Chancellery Tower), Pejabat Bendahari, Pejabat Keselamatan, and Tasik Varsiti.
properties.history: The historic, ceremonial, and intellectual core of Universiti Malaya. Encircles Dewan Tunku Canselor (DTC, 1966 Malaysian Brutalist masterpiece by Kington Loo), the 1.5M-volume Main Library, and picturesque Tasik Varsiti.
properties.capacity_stats: Central university administration, 10,000+ daily visitors, and 4,000-seat convocation hall

properties.name: Research Management & Innovation Complex (KPPI)
properties.description: 9-storey Research Management & Innovation Complex (KPPI / IPPP / UMR) housing central research grant offices, UMXcelerate innovation labs, and IOES.
properties.history: 9-storey flagship complex coordinating UM's RM150M annual research grants, industrial partnerships, and deep-tech commercialization.
departments: Institute of Research Management and Services (IPPP)
Institute of Ocean and Earth Sciences (IOES)
properties.capacity_stats: Houses over 500 post-doctoral researchers, tech entrepreneurs, and IP directors

properties.name: Institute for Advanced Studies (IAS / IPS)
properties.description: Institute for Advanced Studies (IAS / formerly IPS — Institute of Graduate Studies), postgraduate seminar wing, thesis halls, and IOES research unit.
properties.history: Established in 1979 to pioneer high-level interdisciplinary research clusters spanning nanotechnology, quantum dynamics, environmental science, and public policy.
properties.capacity_stats: Supports over 800 doctoral candidates and international visiting fellows

properties.name: Asia-Europe Institute (AEI)
properties.description: ASEAN–EU postgraduate teaching and research institute between IAS/KPPI and KK5.
properties.history: Established in 2000 following Asia-Europe Meeting (ASEM) intergovernmental consensus to promote postgraduate education and scholarly exchange between Asia and Europe.
properties.capacity_stats: Over 250 international graduate diplomats, ambassadors, and policy analysts

properties.name: Rimba Ilmu & Botanical Conservatory
properties.description: 80-hectare Tropical Rainforest Conservatory, herbarium, and environmental research preserve inside UM.
properties.history: Established in 1974 by Prof. W.R. Stanton across 60 hectares of former tin-mining and rubber terrain. Malaysia's first university botanic garden styled as a living tropical rainforest.
properties.capacity_stats: Houses over 1,600 documented tropical plant species in a 60-hectare rainforest sanctuary

properties.name: UM Medical Centre (PPUM / UMMC)
properties.description: Universiti Malaya Medical Centre (PPUM / UMMC) is Malaysia’s premier teaching and referral hospital, comprising Menara Utama, Menara Timur, Menara Selatan, Trauma & Emergency, and the Women & Children Health Complex.
properties.history: Inaugurated in August 1968 by the Yang di-Pertuan Agong. Malaysia's foremost teaching and tertiary hospital, managing 1,600+ beds and pioneering advanced surgical techniques.
properties.capacity_stats: 1,600+ inpatient beds and over 1 million outpatient specialist consultations annually

properties.name: 1st Residential College (KK1 / ASTAR)
properties.description: Kolej Kediaman Tuanku Abdul Rahman (ASTAR / KK1), near Engineering, Law, and RapidKL T789/T815 KK1 stop.
properties.history: Founded in 1959 as Universiti Malaya's oldest residential college, originally housing 28 pioneering students. Named in honor of Malaysia's first Yang di-Pertuan Agong, Tuanku Abdul Rahman.
facilities: Residential Blocks A, B, C, D, E
properties.capacity_stats: Accommodates over 900 undergraduate scholars

properties.name: 2nd Residential College (KK2 / Tuanku Bahiyah)
properties.description: Kolej Kediaman Tuanku Bahiyah (KK2) next to Engineering and DTC.
properties.history: Named in honor of Tuanku Bahiyah, the Sultanah of Kedah and former Chancellor of Universiti Malaya. Celebrated for vibrant cultural and sports traditions.
facilities: Blocks A, B, C, D, E
properties.capacity_stats: Houses over 950 undergraduate residents

properties.name: 3rd Residential College (KK3 / Tuanku Kurshiah)
properties.description: Kolej Kediaman Tuanku Kurshiah (KK3) along Lingkaran Budi, opposite Faculty of Science and FLL.
properties.history: Named after Tunku Kurshiah, Malaysia's first Raja Permaisuri Agong. Centrally located opposite the Faculty of Science along Lingkungan Budi.
properties.capacity_stats: Accommodates over 850 undergraduate scholars

properties.name: 4th Residential College (KK4 / Bestari)
properties.description: Kolej Kediaman Bestari (KK4), west of KK3 & APM on Lingkaran Budi.
properties.history: Known as Kolej Bestari, providing comfortable student residences amidst manicured green hills west of Lingkungan Budi.
properties.capacity_stats: Accommodates over 900 undergraduate students

properties.name: 5th Residential College (KK5 / Dayasari)
properties.description: Kolej Kediaman Dayasari (KK5), north of AEI/IAS and south of UM Arena.
properties.history: Kolej Dayasari is historically a favorite housing residence for students in computing, physical sciences, and sports science due to its central hillside setting.
facilities: Residential Blocks A (Azalea), B (Bougainvilla), C (Camellia), D (Dahlia), E (Episcia)
properties.capacity_stats: Accommodates over 1,000 undergraduate residents

properties.name: 6th Residential College (KK6 / Ibnu Sina)
properties.description: Kolej Kediaman Ibnu Sina (KK6), clinical student college beside Faculty of Medicine & PPUM.
properties.history: Named in honor of the renowned Islamic physician and polymath Avicenna (Ibnu Sina). Dedicated primarily to medical, dental, and biomedical clinical students adjacent to PPUM.
facilities: Blocks A, B, D, E, F
properties.capacity_stats: Accommodates over 850 clinical medical and healthcare students

properties.name: 7th Residential College (KK7 / Za'ba)
properties.description: Kolej Kediaman Za'ba (KK7), beside APM and FSKTM along Lingkungan Budi.
properties.history: Named after the revered Malay scholar, linguist, and nationalist Zainal Abidin Ahmad (Za'ba). Situated along the western rise of Lingkungan Budi near FSKTM and APM.
properties.capacity_stats: Accommodates over 950 undergraduate scholars

properties.name: 8th Residential College (KK8 / Kinabalu)
properties.description: Kolej Kediaman Kinabalu (KK8), northwest campus adjacent to FSKTM and KK10.
properties.history: Named after Mount Kinabalu, symbolizing summit-reaching aspirations. Historically houses students from engineering, science, and computing in the northwestern campus sector.
facilities: Blocks A, B, C, D, E, F
properties.capacity_stats: Accommodates over 1,100 undergraduate residents

properties.name: 9th Residential College (KK9 / Tun Syed Zahiruddin)
properties.description: Kolej Kediaman Tun Syed Zahiruddin (KK9) along Jalan 17/21B, served by UM Shuttle E.
properties.history: Named in honor of Tun Syed Zahiruddin, former Governor of Melaka. Features extensive scenic residential blocks along Jalan 17/21B, served directly by UM Shuttle E.
facilities: Residential Blocks A (Sri Kemboja), C (Sri Worawari), D, E, F
properties.capacity_stats: Accommodates over 1,200 undergraduate scholars

properties.name: 10th Residential College (KK10 / Tun Ahmad Zaidi)
properties.description: Kolej Kediaman Tun Ahmad Zaidi (KK10), adjacent to FSKTM and KK8.
properties.history: Named in honor of Tun Ahmad Zaidi Adruce, former Governor of Sarawak. Situated on the green northern ridge next to FSKTM and KK8 with sweeping panoramic campus views.
properties.capacity_stats: Accommodates over 1,050 undergraduate students

properties.name: 11th Residential College (KK11 / Ungku Aziz)
properties.description: Kolej Kediaman Raja Ungku Aziz (KK11 / KUAZ), next to UM Arena & Sports Centre.
properties.history: Named in tribute to Royal Professor Ungku Abdul Aziz, distinguished economist and legendary former Vice-Chancellor of UM. Adjacent to UM Arena and sports facilities.
properties.capacity_stats: Accommodates over 1,150 undergraduate and student mobility scholars

properties.name: 12th Residential College (KK12 / Raja Dr. Nazrin Shah)
properties.name_ms: Kolej Kediaman Kedua Belas (Raja Dr. Nazrin Shah)
properties.description: Kolej Kediaman Raja Dr. Nazrin Shah (KK12), opposite KPPI & IAS/IPS.
properties.dean_or_office: Pejabat Pengetua Kolej Kediaman Kedua Belas
properties.history: Inaugurated by and named after the Sultan of Perak, Sultan Nazrin Muizzuddin Shah, Chancellor of Universiti Malaya. Modern architectural layout opposite KPPI and IAS.
properties.capacity_stats: Accommodates over 1,400 students across modern residential wings

properties.name: 13th Residential College (KK13)
properties.description: Kolej Kediaman Ke-13 in Seksyen 17 Petaling Jaya, linked to UM Central via UM Shuttle D.
properties.history: Major modern student residence complex in Seksyen 17 Petaling Jaya, operating with modern amenities and linked seamlessly via dedicated UM Shuttle buses.
properties.capacity_stats: Largest student residential complex housing over 3,000 residents

properties.name: International House (UM IH)
properties.description: International House graduate & international student residence in Seksyen 17, served by UM Shuttle D and RapidKL T815 nearby.
properties.history: Designed specifically for international postgraduates, visiting scholars, and exchange academics, providing apartment-style living close to Petaling Jaya transit links.
properties.capacity_stats: Houses over 400 international researchers and visiting global scholars

properties.name: UM Specialist Centre (UMSC)
properties.description: Private specialist teaching hospital affiliated with Universiti Malaya along Lorong Universiti, adjacent to PPUM and the Faculty of Medicine.

properties.name: Wisma R&D Universiti Malaya
properties.description: Universiti Malaya Research & Development tower on Jalan Pantai Baharu housing UMCIC, research clusters, and industry innovation labs near LRT Kerinchi.

properties.name: Masjid Ar-Rahman (UM)
properties.description: Iconic Universiti Malaya mosque at the KL Gate entrance along Jalan Pantai Baharu, serving students, staff, and visitors.

properties.name: Examination Hall (Dewan Peperiksaan)
properties.description: Universiti Malaya's main central examination hall complex located south of KK1 along Jalan Lingkungan Budi.

properties.name: JPPHB — Development & Estate Maintenance
properties.name_ms: Jabatan Pembangunan dan Penyelenggaraan Harta Benda (Pejabat Ketua Pegawai Fasiliti)
properties.description: Office of the Chief Facility Officer (Bangunan JHB), estate maintenance workshops, utilities, and campus development operations.

properties.name: Perpustakaan Utama (Main Library)
properties.description: Central university library housing main collections, Za'ba annex reading rooms, and 24-hour student study spaces.

properties.name: Kompleks Perdanasiswa (KPS)
properties.description: UM student union hub (Blocks A–G), Auditorium KPS, student affairs offices, Student Plaza, and campus dining mall.

properties.name: Dewan Tunku Canselor (DTC)
properties.description: Iconic modernist convocation hall, Experimental Theatre (Panggung Eksperimen), and UM cultural performance venue.

properties.name: High Impact Research (HIR) & Rumah Universiti
properties.name_ms: Bangunan Penyelidikan Berimpak Tinggi & Rumah Universiti
properties.description: Multidisciplinary High Impact Research complex and adjacent Rumah Universiti guest house and administrative wing.
